findings.finding: At the frozen Project-Frankenstein head, tools/native_vision.py explicitly states that Qwen3.5-4B native multimodal inference replaces FrankEye entirely. It sends image+text messages to the local llama-server /v1/chat/completions endpoint and contains no CNN, DINOv2, ONNX or Tesseract pipeline.

The 2026-03-31 cleanup switched error screenshots, VCB integration and WebUI image analysis from tools.frank_eye/get_eye to tools.native_vision/get_vision, making the multimodal Qwen path a runtime successor rather than a side experiment.

The same frozen head README still advertises FrankEye as a 937-line CPU-only pipeline using Digital Retina v8, DINOv2, GOLPU, Tesseract and OpenCV. This contradicts the frozen-head runtime path that says native_vision replaces FrankEye entirely.

NativeVision is a stateless inference bridge over the local multimodal LLM. It does not implement the current v0.1 user-specific Micro Visual Classifier, prototype/version state, trusted-example provenance, open-set calibration, candidate promotion or rollback semantics.

negative_results_and_failure_modes: Frozen-head architecture documentation can lag executable routing by at least one major vision-backend replacement; H1 baseline capture must privilege executable code and runtime receipts over README descriptions.

Replacing a structured deterministic sensor stack with direct multimodal LLM inference can erase explicit intermediate evidence, latency decomposition and calibrated familiarity surfaces unless those are reintroduced as first-class state.
Native multimodal output is model-generated semantic interpretation and must not be treated as sensor truth or trusted adaptive-learning labels by default.
A single-model vision path may simplify deployment but couples perception latency/availability to the shared LLM server; this must be measured rather than assumed cheaper than FrankEye.

reuse: Use Qwen3.5 native multimodal inference as one candidate semantic visual interpreter in H1/H3, because it is the actual frozen-head PF runtime path.
Keep a separate deterministic/evidence feature surface for adaptive familiarity and open-set gating even if native multimodal inference supplies high-level descriptions.
Make visual backend identity/version an explicit runtime state so replay can distinguish FrankEye, native_vision and future dissolved Retina paths.
Generate architecture docs from executable configuration/manifests or regression-check docs against runtime routing.
current_architecture_delta.recommended_discriminating_test: On H1 target hardware, compare native Qwen3.5 vision against FrankEye and hybrid native-vision+MVC on the same photo/screenshot/OOD corpus. Measure semantic task accuracy, OCR/UI accuracy, p50/p95 latency, LLM contention, CPU/GPU/RAM cost, structured-evidence availability and user-specific familiarity gains.
